The Example Family Cookbook
Invented recipes and invented names, for testing the legacy converter.
Contents: see the categories after each title.

CHEESE BALL	Appetizers	Aunt Example
1 8-oz pkg cream cheese, softened
1 cup Cheese--Cheddar, shredded
1/4 cup chopped pecans
1 tsp Worcestershire sauce
Mix cream cheese, cheddar and Worcestershire sauce until smooth. Shape into a ball.
Roll in pecans and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

CORN BREAD	Breads	Grandma Placeholder
1 cup Flour--All Purpose
1 cup corn meal
2 tbsp sugar
1½ cups buttermilk
1 egg
Heat oven to 425 degrees and grease an 8-inch square pan.
Stir everything together just until moistened and pour into the pan. Bake 20-25 minutes, until golden.

CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES	Desserts	Cookies	Cousin Sample
1 cup butter, softened
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup Sugar--Brown, packed
2 eggs
2¼ cups Flour--All Purpose
1 tsp baking soda
1 12-oz bag chocolate chips
Cream butter and both sugars, then beat in the eggs.
Add flour and soda, then stir in the chips. Drop by teaspoons onto a baking sheet and bake at 375 for 9 to 11 minutes.

LEMON POPPY SEED CAKE	Desserts	Cakes	Chef Example
1 box Cake Mix--Lemon
1 3.4-oz pkg instant lemon pudding
4 eggs
1/2 cup oil
2 tbsp poppy seeds
Glaze:
1 cup Sugar--Powdered
2 tbsp lemon juice
Beat cake mix, pudding, eggs, oil and 1 cup water for 2 minutes; stir in the poppy seeds.
Bake in a greased bundt pan at 350 for 45-50 minutes. Mix the glaze and drizzle it over the warm cake.

HAMBURGER CASSEROLE	Main Dishes	Casseroles	Microwave/Cousin Sample
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, chopped
1 10¾-oz can cream of mushroom soup
2 cups cooked noodles
Crumble the beef and onion into a 2-quart dish. Microwave on high 5-6 minutes, stirring once; drain.

SPECIAL SAUCE:
Stir the soup with 1/2 cup milk and a dash of pepper until smooth.
Add the noodles and sauce to the beef. Cover and microwave 4 minutes more.

SUGAR-FREE FRUIT SALAD	Salads	Sugar free	Neighbor Invented
2 cups diced melon
1 cup grapes
1 cup sliced strawberries
2-3 tbsp orange juice
Toss the fruit with the orange juice and chill.

ROOT BEER FLOAT	Beverages	Uncle Fictional
2 scoops vanilla ice cream
1 can root beer, chilled

PARTY PUNCH	Beverages	Aunt Exmple	Holiday
Pour one can of frozen lemonade concentrate, one quart of pineapple juice and two liters of ginger ale over an ice ring in a punch bowl. Stir gently and serve right away.

CORNMEAL MUFFINS	Breads	Grandma Placeholder
For 3 dozen:	for 1 dozen:
3 cups corn meal	1 cup
3 cups Flour--All Purpose	1 cup
3/4 cup sugar	1/4 cup
3 eggs	1 egg
Mix the dry ingredients, add the eggs and enough milk for a thick batter, and bake in muffin tins at 400 for 15 minutes.

FRIED EGGS—easiest way	Breakfast Dishes	Uncle Fictional
2 eggs
1 tbsp butter
salt and pepper
Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-low heat. Crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 3 minutes.

LAYERED SALAD	Salads	Cousin Sample	Make ahead
1 head lettuce, torn
1 cup frozen peas
1 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup Cheese--Swiss, shredded
Layer lettuce and peas in a glass bowl, spread mayonnaise over the top to seal, and sprinkle with cheese.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.

BROCCOLI BAKE	Vegetables	Aunt Example
2 10-oz pkg frozen broccoli, thawed
1 can cream of chicken soup
1/2 cup Cheese--Cheddar, grated
Topping: 1/2 cup cracker crumbs mixed with 2 tbsp melted butter
Put broccoli in a casserole, pour the soup over it, and top with cheese and the crumb topping.
Bake at 350 for 30 minutes.

PEANUT BUTTER FUDGE	Desserts	Microwave	Aunt Example
1 12-oz pkg Chips--Peanut Butter
1 14-oz can sweetened condensed milk
1 tsp vanilla
Microwave the chips and milk 2 minutes, stir until smooth, add vanilla, and spread in a buttered 8-inch pan.
